clause: Symbol-set placement/manipulation dedup onto instance transforms [STU-DS-002a]

scope.summary: Implement the symbol-set placement and manipulation tooling (the spray/shift/scrunch/size/spin/stain/screen/style family) as per-instance transform and style operations over a group of StudioComponentInstance nodes; a symbol set is a group of instances, not a distinct primitive. No symbol-tool product name is a Studio command name; each operation is a typed command on the selected instance group.
acceptance_criteria: symbol-set behaviors dedup onto instance transforms/styles; no separate primitive; author_id + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: instance-set tools reachable via author_id
test: spray/shift/scrunch/size/spin/stain/screen/style apply as per-instance transform/style ops on an instance group; no distinct symbol-set primitive

target_entries: Studio / Design Systems / Instance sets (spray, size, spin, style)

risk_if_missed: Symbol-set tooling forks a second primitive; dedup violation.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
